author: Posighdun
body:
Im looking for a decent team to join. What can i provide to that team? Well i am a defender, I defend the monument like my life when i play dtm. I have a different defence for each dtm map and i am currently studying the tourney maps. I am fairly better then the average avicus player at pvp, somedays i get good ping and other days less then good ping.  Anyway the point is i can provide your team with a solid defence. 

Btw my timezone is AWST.
